request.style: English, male tenor solo with choral backing, cello, piano, flute, strings, hopeful and majestic, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Against all hope he looked ahead
And believed in what was not yet seen
His body felt like deadness grew
Yet his trust in God never waned

[Chorus]
He did not waver in unbelief
But was strengthened in his faith
He gave glory to the God of life
And believed the promise would come to pass

[Verse]
Convinced that God has power to act
To do exactly what He said
Things that are not become as though they were
Because He gives the dead new breath

[Chorus]
He did not waver in unbelief
But was strengthened in his faith
He gave glory to the God of life
And believed the promise would come to pass

[Bridge]
It was credited to him as righteousness
For he trusted in the living God
We who believe in Him who raised
Our Lord from the dead share this hope

[Chorus]
He did not waver in unbelief
But was strengthened in his faith
He gave glory to the God of life
And believed the promise would come to pass

[Outro]
Strengthened in faith, we give glory
To the God who calls things into being
